Name: Sir Robert's Elegant and Refined Flowers
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][u][b]Description[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]This is another chapter in my on-going flower and plant series. It features flowers in pretty glass vases, polka-dotted vases and colorful pots. I have a selection of tulips, pansies and sunflowers as well as flowers that I "recycled" from my previous mods. I like to have a lot of options, so you'll find various shapes and sizes! Mix & match them with other flower and plants from my mods to create a charming ambiance to your farmhouse in Stardew Valley.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]There are 10 basic flower images and each one has a variety of alternative textures to choose from. The 11th image is for a selection of flowers that have been moved up several pixels to fit on countertops. This way you can decorate end tables AND kitchen countertops. Go wild & crazy! [/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][u][b]Installation instructions[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Install the latest version of SMAPI. Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods. (Everything you need will be in the main folder). When you play the game, the flowers can be found in the Decor/Houseplant section of the furniture catalog or Happy Home Designer.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][u][b]Main features[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Image #1 through #10 features flowers that can be placed onto end tables.[/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Image #11 features flowers that can be placed onto countertops. They have been moved up a few pixels.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][u][b]Requirements[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Requires the Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. I also recommend using Happy Home Designer to make your life easier.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][u][b]Shout outs[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]The end tables by Platinum Cats, Orangeblossom7, stardust, and Riruru. I also used end tables from the actual game. The kitchen countertops are by Platinum Cats.[/size][/color]
